reason: Prior measurements do not establish a winner: the reference remains near 1,000 GFLOP/s in Low Power, and the tested panel32 variant was not promoted in either battery mode. Rank traversal and B-layout changes first because they directly target reuse or access locality in the recorded 512-step, 512-byte B and 256-byte packed-A streams while retaining the supplied full-kernel helper. Prefetching is a smaller, distinct test, but its timed issue cost and lack of cache evidence lower confidence. The K-loop simplification is conditional on confirming the current two-K body; related schedules did not promote. Panel64 needs a new validated helper, transpose experiments need substantial new kernels, and alignment has no recorded failure. Address-generation change is last because similar loop-control changes produced no repeatable gain.
